name: Iretis
description: A former Meletian city ruled by King Kedarick VI, destroyed by leonin and claimed by Phenax as a necropolis.

description_citations.text: "Returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
timeline.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
timeline.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kedarick sends his advisor Udaen, secretly Ashiok, to broker the peace treaty.
timeline.quote: Kedarick sent his advisor Udaen to broker the treaty

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thoros offers support for peace, then pulls his nephew's head from his satchel blaming the leonin, and lunges at Kedarick; Kedarick beheads him.
timeline.quote: Thoros himself was beheaded by Kedarick, his former friend.

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A leonin army marches on Iretis; Ashiok falsely tells Kedarick his wife and child were murdered, and Kedarick stabs out his own eyes.
timeline.quote: Kedarick drew his dagger and stabbed himself first in one eye, then the other

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals themself as mastermind; Phenax claims Iretis for his Returned.
timeline.quote: Phenax would have the city to house his Returned

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leonin destroy Iretis through the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by leonin thanks to the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Locations in Oreskos's surroundings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax makes a pact with Ashiok to lay waste to Iretis in exchange for hiding Ashiok from the other gods.
timeline.quote: Phenax made a pact with the nightmare planeswalker Ashiok

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Cooperation with Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Phenax plague Iretis and the leonin with nightmares until the leonin destroy the polis; Phenax claims it as a necropolis.
timeline.quote: Phenax then claimed Iretis as a new necropolis for his Returned.
